item.title: Scrumboard - A Jira-ersatz to teach agile software development
item.description: Over the past few years, we’ve been developing a web-based tool to support students tracking their progress in an agile software development course. In this blog, I’ll explain why we moved away from professional / industry-grade tools and decided to (not) reinvent the wheel.

item.title: Teaching about Scrum with paper
item.description: I’ll talk about how we teach about Scrum events and principles in a gamified context. First of all, the whole credit goes to Sonja Hof et al.. You may check their paper (just click on Sonja’s name, it’s a hyperref) that we modified a little and tried to adapt to fix the issues they witnessed in their experiment. One day, I actually should try to contact that team to see if they still do this tutorial and if they changed anything.
